purpose: Center debate, conflict, or activity on a disputed topic.
keywords: N + をめぐって; N + をめぐる + N
Residents were divided over the new road.
Ownership of a painting was disputed.
formation: N + をめぐって; N + をめぐる + N
restrictions: Common with discussions, disputes, and competing interests.
mistake: Use について for a neutral topic without surrounding activity.
